title: Charge Line charging networks and typical prices
description: Australian fast-charging networks, how to recognise their sites, and a typical price per kWh. Networks price each site differently; these are a guide. Property order is the canonical order in networks.json.

updated.description: The day the data last changed (YYYY-MM-DD).

other.description: Prices for a site whose network isn't listed.

id.description: Never renamed or removed. The seven networks the app has always known keep the app's names.

match.description: Lower-case text found in a site's operator or name in OpenStreetMap or Open Charge Map.

typicalPerKWh.description: Typical A$ per kWh at its fast chargers; null until a source gives one.

teslaPerKWh.description: Tesla Supercharger only: the price for Tesla drivers.

freeKWhPerDay.description: Free energy each day at its fast chargers, before the price applies.

basis.description: published: the network's own page; survey: news or a survey of sites; estimate: worked out from listings; none: no price yet.

siteReading.description: Whether an agent may read the network's own website: its terms allow it, forbid it, the site refuses automated readers, or nobody has checked.
